features.description: Apply and verify the frozen two-clock startup and exclusion-diagnostic patch
acceptance_criteria: AC1: The registry bootstrap, template report and integrity sweep use a fresh parent-derived 9 s context; startup remains 9 s. Run announces, answers health and shuts down in the slow-client fixture. No whole-startup wall-time bound is claimed.

AC2: All failed profiles, including a genuine refusal recorded late, are excluded with reasons retained and no implicit default; a failed explicit --exec-profile refuses startup. The episode receives the existing named refusal.

AC3: Log, health comments, doctor, help and QUICKSTART report only recording times, retain genuine refusal reasons and advise review before conditional restart. Doctor names every exclusion as an exec failure (exit 13), including --quick.

AC4: OutOfTime is true only for a nonempty failed-arm set all recorded at/after the deadline. Mixed, no-failure and no-deadline rows remain false; late genuine refusal may be true. R3/R9 retain both ambiguous directions and establish no scheduling bound.

AC5: Inventory the actual Go sources, preserving imported/local function-value and direct-call detection plus alias/nested/shadow controls. Expect 60 test New references, zero production New references after apply, and four internal production construction edges. A new compatibility caller requires reviewed design, never an allowlist expansion to hide red.

AC6: False exclusion JSON retains old bytes via omitempty; true adds out_of_time. Doctor reason is one line and at most 240 bytes including the 3-byte ellipsis (237-byte prefix); project, file and fixed prose are outside this cap.

AC7: Fresh-phase cancellation reaches registry-bootstrap with context.Canceled, settlement is bounded and writer authority reopens. Existing cancellation/settlement/context-root neighbours remain green. Mutating startup clocks and execStartupHook are serial; successful T1 lifecycle must be exercised outside sandbox under race.

AC8: Apply the frozen 11-file patch byte-exact, assert all four new files and all thirteen new named tests, preserve docs/help and existing neighbours. Current-head focused gates, controller full gates, independent evaluation and PR/merge Linux plain/race CI are required; sandbox socket verdicts are uninformative. V27/V29 archive receipts are reusable only after all eleven hashes match.

AC9: Listen, announce, serving, maintenance and shutdown remain owned by Run's original parent, never its spent startup clock. Require successful announced-service health plus the compiling serve-parent mutation killed at the health assertion.
